newsitem.title: USA: General Re Fairfield deal gets regulatory ok.
newsitem.headline: General Re Fairfield deal gets regulatory ok.

text.p: General Re Corp said on Tuesday its acquisition of Fairfield Insurance Co, a subsidiary of National Re Corp, received final regulatory approval, from the state of Connecticut.
General Re said in a statement the Connecticut state insurance commissioner had approved the Fairfield acquisition.
"The Connecticut approval was the final regulatory approval needed to close the transaction," it said.
National Re shareholders would vote on September 30 on whether to accept the merger with General Re and receive cash or General Re shares, General Re said.
The merger proposal was approved by the Delaware Insurance Department on August 19.
General Re said it expected to close the merger early in the fourth quarter 1996 if it won approval from the commissioner and shareholders.
General Re owns General Reinsurance, the largest professional property/casualty reinsurer in the United States.
